c: Hats summons a pile of random hats on the character's head. Each hat projectile is then thrown at the closest enemy, randomly, and at the faced direction, cycling between the three options, getting slightly faster for each hat in a stack. The hat bounces onto other enemies or off the screen up to 2 times. When the pile of hats is depleted, a new pile appears. There can be a stack of at most 10 hats.
Hats are randomly assigned a hidden hat type which could have a special property:
Bowler Hat deals max knockback of the enemy or a max of 10, whichever is lower.
Pickle Haube (pickelhaube) always freeze enemies and last longer with
Top Hat has an acceleration 2.5 times that of the other hats after bouncing. The final hat of a stack will always be one because of the pun.
Other hats that do not have special abilities are Fez, Cap, Hard Hat, and Normal.
